scope: Existing archived fire-device installation references, selected supplementary archived datasheets and dedicated Hochiki installation guides. This is a selected reviewed batch, not a claim of complete archive coverage.

imageMethod.selection: Visual inspection of source-page renders/contact sheets, then manual applicability/edition review
imageMethod.derivative: Complete PDF page rendered with PyMuPDF and encoded lossless WebP
imageMethod.largerPages: 1800–3400 pixels for small print and imposed multi-page sheets

associationNotes: Generic CHQ-ARI device row is deliberately not linked to the CHQ-ARI(CLR)-only manual. That diagram remains searchable in the manual gallery.

ESP sensor instructions explicitly cover the listed sensor families and all variants. Only illustrated base types and applicable existing device rows are associated. YBN-R/3(SCI) refers to a different wiring instruction.
Protec 6000PLUS/BASE is associated with the archived common-base datasheet because the source explicitly provides its separate loop wiring drawing.
No new manual records, device rows, panel rows, pack membership, source URLs, or saved-PDF identity hashes were modified.
